## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] For the 5–100 GB continuous-backup usage band, published regional ranges are AWS $1.00–$1.55, Azure $1.00–$3.95 and Google Cloud $0.60–$0.95 per GB-month. MongoDB’s AWS US_EAST_1 example bills 115 GB at $106.25/month after 5 GB free. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup storage rates by region
- [statement] Scheduled backup invoices use GB-days: daily unit rate = monthly unit rate × 12 / 365. At $0.14/GB-month, 400 GB retained for 30 days costs about $55.20. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup storage rates by region · also: https://www.ohchimp.com/blog/mongodb-atlas-continuous-backup-costs
- [statement] Continuous backup prices snapshots plus oplog by region and usage band. MongoDB’s AWS US_EAST_1 example gives 5 GB free, then 95 GB at $1.00 and 15 GB at $0.75: $106.25/month for 115 GB. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup storage rates by region · also: https://www.ohchimp.com/blog/mongodb-atlas-continuous-backup-costs

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] A January 28, 2026 user comment reports inability to reproduce backup storage billing because underlying calculation inputs were unavailable. This is a user-reported observability limitation, not a verified statement of every current Atlas API capability. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-01-28) — https://feedback.mongodb.com/ideas/CUSTOMER-I-8652 · keywords: Backup storage rates by region

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Continuous backup uses a different tiered schedule on combined snapshot and oplog storage. Its first 5 GB are free, and the independent regional comparison says continuous backup can be cheaper than plain snapshots below its regional crossover. Compare the applicable volume tiers rather than treating plain-snapshot pricing as a universal lower bound. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup storage rates by region · also: https://www.ohchimp.com/blog/mongodb-atlas-continuous-backup-costs
- [statement] OhChimp calculates a 6.6× continuous-versus-snapshot price ratio for 115 GB using $106.25 versus $16.10. This is an equal-billable-volume illustration, not a measured universal premium or identical recovery capability. (low confidence) — https://www.ohchimp.com/blog/mongodb-atlas-continuous-backup-costs · keywords: Backup storage rates by region

## Facts and statements

- [statement] For dedicated-cluster Cloud Backups without continuous backup, MongoDB publishes USD/GB-month ranges of AWS $0.14–$0.19, Azure $0.34–$0.65 and Google Cloud $0.08–$0.12; the applicable rate depends on the snapshot storage region. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup storage rates by region · also: https://www.ohchimp.com/blog/mongodb-atlas-continuous-backup-costs
- [statement] Backup mode is evaluated independently in each copy region: a continuous primary backup can coexist with snapshot-only copies, and the copy region then uses the plain Cloud Backup Storage SKU. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup storage rates by region
- [statement] Copying all backups to another region approximately doubles stored volume; destination regional rates and cross-region transfer determine the additional dollars. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup storage rates by region · also: https://www.pointfive.co/efficiency-hub/inefficiencies/excessive-snapshot-retention-and-cross-region-copies-in-mongodb-atlas-cloud-backup
- [statement] Snapshot storage is normally incremental, but failover or configuration changes can require another full snapshot. Provider reporting can make billable backup storage reach provisioned volume capacity. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup storage rates by region · also: https://www.ohchimp.com/blog/mongodb-atlas-continuous-backup-costs
- [statement] Budget backup storage separately from the cluster hourly price; Percona and an IBM Community practitioner both identify backup as an additional Atlas cost dimension. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-04-14) — https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-pricing-explained-what-youre-really-paying-for/ · keywords: Backup storage rates by region · also: https://community.ibm.com/community/user/blogs/manish-negandhi/2026/04/14/optimizing-mongodb-atlas-cost
- [statement] Align backup policy with recovery objectives before reducing retention or extra-region copies. PointFive identifies unnecessary non-production retention and copies as waste; the IBM Community author recommends aligning backups to RPO/RTO SLAs. (medium confidence) — https://www.pointfive.co/efficiency-hub/inefficiencies/excessive-snapshot-retention-and-cross-region-copies-in-mongodb-atlas-cloud-backup · keywords: Backup storage rates by region · also: https://community.ibm.com/community/user/blogs/manish-negandhi/2026/04/14/optimizing-mongodb-atlas-cost
- [statement] MongoDB’s April 27, 2026 status updates, reproduced by IsDown, identified erroneous backup charges for April 24 and promised automatic refunds. A backup invoice spike therefore does not by itself prove a regional rate change. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-31) — https://isdown.app/status/mongodb/incidents/577410-spike-in-billing-for-backup-usage · keywords: Backup storage rates by region
- [statement] Backup volume can exceed live data: failover, configuration changes, and cloud-provider maintenance can require additional full snapshots. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/billing/cluster-configuration-costs/ · keywords: Backup storage rates by region · also: https://www.ohchimp.com/blog/mongodb-atlas-continuous-backup-costs
- [statement] Percona’s independent cost analysis treats backup storage and PITR as separate budget items beyond the instance price; its article does not supply a regional backup tariff dataset. (low confidence) — https://www.percona.com/blog/mongodb-pricing-explained-what-youre-really-paying-for/ · keywords: Backup storage rates by region
